description: Reviewed pre-existing direct write call shapes. Line numbers are intentionally excluded so harmless edits do not churn the baseline; new path/call pairs fail the release gate.

allowed.reason: Existing undo/backup cache snapshots and JSON configuration output. Authoritative life.txt writes remain routed through mutation; config output should move to a dedicated atomic config writer in a future cleanup.
Generated JSON Schema publication output, not an authoritative life.txt/state mutation.

Durable transaction-journal primitive. The implementation fsyncs the temporary file, atomically replaces the journal/artifact path, and fsyncs the parent directory so interrupted multi-target operations remain recoverable. This reviewed low-level operational-state writer is intentionally separate from authoritative life.txt mutation routing.

Bounded backup rotation in the dedicated atomic configuration writer. This is the reviewed home the write-route baseline previously called for: config writes validate against config-v1.schema.json, keep a bounded .bak rotation via os.replace, and commit atomically through atomic_write_text. It writes JSON configuration, not authoritative life.txt/state, so it is intentionally separate from mutation routing.
